name: harrier
notes: View-model in camera space (camera at origin looking -Z, ~58 deg vertical FOV); one armature 'harrier_rig' with the gauntlet arms (art/_shared/fp_arms.py v2) + gun. Every clip starts and ends on the idle base pose (idle frame 0). fire: 0.10 s, ~2.8 cm rearward + ~1.8 deg climb in the first two frames, vents snap open, back within ~1 mm by 83 ms: restart it on every shot at 12 shots/s (fade ~0.01 s); its 'glow' curve multiplies coil_glow (2.6x peak). idle and sprint loop seamlessly (sprint = one stride, 0.733 s = 44 frames; scale timeScale with run speed). reload events: mag_out (spent cell released and flying off-screen on bone 'cell_spent'), mag_in (heel slap seats the fresh cell), rack (charging handle back). Bones 'cell' and 'cell_spent' are hidden by scale (0.001) when not in use; every clip keys their scale. Emissive materials to drive: coil_glow (shroud coils, muzzle emitter and the heat-sink fins behind the rear-left louvres: heat), cell_glow (charge window: ammo), dash_glow on meshes 'dash_glow_0' (nearer the wrist) and 'dash_glow_1' on the back of the left hand (clone the material per mesh; one segment per dash charge). reticle_glow and sight_glass are alpha-blended. Sockets: socket_muzzle (+Y bone axis out of the muzzle), socket_eject (cell port, axis out of the port), socket_mag (on the cell). Rigid part bones the game may also drive: flap_l, flap_r, trigger, barrel, charging_handle, cell, cell_latch, selector.
